s3Endpoint.title: S3 endpoint URL
s3Endpoint.description: Base URL of the S3-compatible object store. Example: https://s3.us-south.cloud-object-storage.appdomain.cloud

s3Bucket.title: Bucket name
s3Bucket.description: Name of the bucket that holds the model archive.

s3Key.title: Object key prefix
s3Key.description: S3 prefix of the Triton model repository inside the bucket. Example: models/mkumatag/fraud
